name: Enhancements for Domains in Fabric
description: Domains and sub domains enable structuring the data in the organization while enabling optimized consumption experience per business needs.We plan to strengthen the governance controls such as delegated settings and defining default sensitivity label per domain, and to allow more consumption experiences such as the ability to search by domain/sub domain, filter the WS by domain/sub domain and see the domains details as part of the item location.
